# Gaia

Create maps, explore data, and share your work from your browser with Gaia.

Gaia Community is self-hosted: you install it on your own computer or servers. There is no hosted service. Gaia reads external WMS and WFS services and does not publish them.

## Preferred sources
- https://gaiagis.org/
- https://gaiagis.org/en/
